surface: The autocomplete editor: opening it on a cell, arrowing through its choices, typing to narrow the list, and Enter committing the choice.

steps.note: Enter opens the editor on the cell holding `Al`: a text field with the combobox role over a listbox of the choices that match `Al` (Alpha, Alfa, Alto). Required: the text, the role and the open list (`expanded`, on every reader). NVDA reads the field (`combo box, collapsed, has auto complete, editable, Al`) and then `expanded`. Finding, new with the combobox markup: VoiceOver reads the list that opens instead of the field (`expanded list box A, row 1 3 items` with Chromium, `expanded list A, row 1 3 items` with WebKit), so it says neither the text nor the combo box role. The field takes the focus collapsed and is expanded a moment later, when the first query fills the list; the dropdown editor does the same, and VoiceOver has read its field in one run and not in the next.

ArrowDown highlights the first choice. The focus stays in the text field and aria-activedescendant names the option, and every reader reads it with its position: NVDA `list. Alpha, 1 of 3`, VoiceOver with Chromium `Alpha menu item, group (1 of 3)`, VoiceOver with WebKit `Alpha selected (1 of 3)`. The same on this step and the next two.

Typing `f` after `Al` rebuilds the list with Alfa, the one choice that matches `Alf`. The typing supersedes the arrow pick of the steps before, so the list drops it and highlights nothing (Enter would commit the typed text), and the polite live region says what is left, `1 choice available: Alfa`, so the change is read without a focus move (4.1.3). VoiceOver reads it with both browsers (with Chromium after the field, `Alf, A, row 1, list box pop up, expanded, combo box`). The NVDA goldens predate the change: there the pick (Alto) stayed on the one row left, and NVDA read Alfa as a highlighted option with its place in the source, `Alfa, 2 of 3`.

ArrowDown highlights Alfa, the one choice left (`1 of 1`), so that Enter commits it: without this step Enter commits the typed text, `Alf`. VoiceOver reads it (`Alfa selected (1 of 1)` with WebKit, `Alfa menu item, group (1 of 1)` with Chromium). The NVDA goldens predate the change: there the highlight was on Alfa already, the key did not move it, and nothing was said.

Enter commits Alfa and moves the selection one row down (enterMoves), to the next row's cell, which holds `Al`. Required: that cell's value and its row. The focus reaches the cell and every reader reads it (NVDA `Al, A, row 3, column 2`). VoiceOver names no row on any cell move (its behavior, grid-core).
ArrowUp moves to the edited cell, which now holds the committed choice, `Alfa`. Every reader reads the cell: the arrow key takes the focus from the closed field back to the grid.
